poem.author: 杜甫
englishLines: In the lengthening sun, rivers and hills glow,
Spring wind carries the scent of flowers and grass.
Swallows fly with soft mud for their nests,
Mandarin ducks sleep on the warm sand.

appreciation.zh: 春日渐长，江山明丽，风里带着花草香。燕子忙着衔泥筑巢，鸳鸯却在暖沙上安静睡觉，一忙一静都是春天。
appreciation.en: Longer spring days brighten river and hills while fragrant wind moves through flowers. Swallows busily build nests, and mandarin ducks rest on warm sand—spring holds both motion and stillness.

pages.zhText:
迟日江山丽，
春风花草香。
泥融飞燕子，
沙暖睡鸳鸯。
pages.enText:
In the lengthening sun, rivers and hills glow,
Spring wind carries the scent of flowers and grass.
Swallows fly with soft mud for their nests,
Mandarin ducks sleep on the warm sand.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Radiant Tang countryside by a gentle river on a long spring afternoon, green hills, flowers and fresh grass, two swallows carrying tiny mud pellets, a pair of mandarin ducks asleep on warm sandbar, a gentle Tang poet in muted blue robe observes from bank, no text.

pages.zhText:
迟日江山丽，
春天的白天慢慢变长，阳光把山河照得明亮又柔和。
pages.enText:
In the lengthening sun, rivers and hills glow.
The longer spring day lights the land with a gentle brightness.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide luminous view of same river and rounded hills under late-afternoon spring sun, same poet on bank, clear soft light across water and fields, no birds prominent yet, no text.

pages.zhText:
春风花草香。
风从花丛和青草间走过，把清新的香气送到四周。
pages.enText:
Spring wind carries the scent of flowers and grass.
The breeze passes through blossoms and fresh grass, carrying their scent.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Low meadow view with same poet breathing in gently, spring breeze ripples colorful small wildflowers and new grass toward the river, scent suggested by light ink-wash curls, no text.

pages.zhText:
泥融飞燕子，
河边的泥土变得松软，燕子一次次衔回小泥团筑巢。
pages.enText:
Swallows fly with soft mud for their nests.
Soft riverside mud lets swallows carry little pieces home.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Two graceful swallows swoop safely above same soft riverbank, each carrying a tiny natural mud pellet toward a simple nest beneath Tang farmhouse eave, same poet watches from distance, no text.

pages.zhText:
沙暖睡鸳鸯。
被太阳晒暖的沙洲上，一对鸳鸯把头藏进羽毛里睡着了。
pages.enText:
Mandarin ducks sleep on the warm sand.
On the sun-warmed sandbar, a pair tucks in their heads and sleeps.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Tender close scene of one pair of mandarin ducks peacefully sleeping on warm golden sandbar, calm shallow water and soft reflections, same landscape in background, no human near birds, no text.

pages.zhText: 阳光暖，花草香。燕子忙着安家，鸳鸯安心休息，整条河岸都在过春天。
pages.enText: Sunshine warms and flowers scent the air. Swallows build while ducks rest, and the whole riverbank lives through spring.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Balanced panorama of same riverbank showing swallows busy near nest at one side and sleeping ducks on sandbar at the other, flowers and poet connect the scene, calm child-friendly rhythm, no text.

pages.zhText: 春天既有轻快的翅膀，也有暖暖的梦。你愿意跟燕子飞一会儿，还是陪鸳鸯睡一觉？
pages.enText: Spring has quick wings and warm dreams. Would you fly with the swallows or rest beside the ducks?
pages.illustrationPrompt: Dreamy playful composition with same poet seated under flowering tree, swallows arc overhead while ducks remain asleep below, afternoon light and ample rice-paper space, no fantasy human flight, no text.

pages.zhText:
迟日江山丽，
春风花草香。
泥融飞燕子，
沙暖睡鸳鸯。
再轻轻读一遍吧。
pages.enText:
In the lengthening sun, rivers and hills glow,
Spring wind carries the scent of flowers and grass.
Swallows fly with soft mud for their nests,
Mandarin ducks sleep on the warm sand.
Now read it softly once more.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Closing golden spring view, swallows return to their nest, ducks still rest on sand, same poet walks home along flowered river path, glowing hills and water, no text.
